summary: The mode smoke test's per-mode override gained a Domains field (0 = the old one-team-a-seat-up-to-three), so a mode can be seated 2v2; ModeSmokeDriver reads it through ModeSmokeConfigSO.DomainsFor.
why: Riposte seats 4 as 2v2 in the game; the smoke test always split 4 seats into 3 teams, so its matches were not the game's.
